howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先选定一个明确的美学方向,再产出可运行的前端代码(HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等),在字体、配色、动效、布局上避开常见的 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你构建网页、页面或应用组件,并想避开千篇一律的 AI 风格设计时,它会接管美学方向与代码实现。

say.text: 帮我做个作品集页面,走粗野主义,排版大胆一点。
用 React 写个产品落地页,配色和动效要有辨识度。
say.note: 产出可运行的组件代码。

say.text: 这个界面太普通了,换个思路重做,极简但精致。

howto.what_en: Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction, then writes working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) that avoids generic AI-style fonts, colors, layouts, and motion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you build a web page, page, or app component and want to avoid cookie-cutter AI-looking design; it takes over the aesthetic direction and the code.

say_en.text: Build me a portfolio page in a brutalist style with bold typography.
say_en.note: Picks a direction first, then codes.

say_en.text: Make a React product landing page with distinctive color and motion.
This UI looks generic, redo it minimal but refined.
